  UNDERAGE GIRL SECOND TO SUE BILLIONAIRE
 Billionaire Jeffrey Epstein, serving time in jail for soliciting erotic massages and sexual acts from underage girls, had another lawsuit filed
 against him for the same allegations.
 The suit filed this week by Palm Beach Gardens attorney Spencer Kuvin is the seventh such suit against the investment banker and
 registered sex offender. It is the second one Kuvin filed against him.
 Kuvin said the girl, identified in the suit as B.B., was 15 in 2005 when Epstein's assistant                              . who is also a defendant in the suit,
 recruited the girl for an erotic massage and sex acts. He said B.B. came forward after se in                         rr   dia coverage about Epstein.
 Kuvin is seeking excess of $15,000 to cover the damages.
 "All she wants is to make sure she's taken care of in respect to medical needs and psychological treatment," Kuvin said. "This is
 something that's going to affect her for the rest of her life. She's traumatized, and she wants justice."
 Epstein's attorney. Robert Critton Jr., could not be reached for comment, despite attempts by phone.
